answer: Agents can count valuable actions only after a bond stays locked through a challenge window. Peers compare signed histories, and each receipt is tied to one key and prior state, so a mirror account cannot reuse another agent's proof. If coordinated duplicates are demonstrated, their bonds are slashed. A sybil attacker must fund and lock capital for every identity, while a vine of cheap accounts earns no added trust. At a summit, agents can raise the bond threshold if attacks continue.
